rule: This map links concepts to surfaces that may need alignment. It does not assert that the current wording is canonical.

concepts.corpusQuestion: What is the exact authority hierarchy among canonical corpus, Scroll/Megillah, implementations, Seer, tests, research and public explanations?
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar: current-status/development docs on normative reference
Pastafarian-Calendar-App: docs that use canonical/normative terminology
concepts.specialTrap: Do not confuse Seer API presentation='canonical' or App 'canonical domain' with semantic authority.

concepts.corpusQuestion: What does normative must/must-not mean for conformance, and what project/legal layers are explicitly outside that meaning?
surfaces: license/IP documentation only where a legal statement is actually made
concepts.specialTrap: A specification constraint on a conforming implementation is not by itself a legal, moral, religious or social prohibition.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Exact definition of date as function of working/calculation day c and target day t.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-App: Temporal Context, Calculation-Day Override, structural view resolver

concepts.corpusQuestion: Exact five-field date tuple and semantic identity of name fields.
concepts.specialTrap: Machine canonical indices and public localized names are different layers.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Semantic identity, authoritative Hebrew/source forms, permitted translations/transliterations and local numeric-base rendering.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-App: localization catalogs and representation provider
Pastafarian-Calendar: source-language catalogs in all 60 implementation branches
concepts.knownAnomaly: JavaScript+Interlingue README says Karshumab while source/test require Karshumav.
concepts.specialTrap: Do not infer semantic identity from whichever display string is currently executable.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Diagonal c=t rule, converse, year 0/negative years, directional implications.
Year length, cutlet count/continuity/minimum, month count/length/weaving and structural ordering constraints.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-Seer: structure/boundaries output, exact runtime data

concepts.corpusQuestion: Whether canonical calendar defines any week system.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-App: ordinary Week and Work Week product views
localized help/UI where weekly view could be mistaken for Pastafarian structure
concepts.specialTrap: A product may offer a civil/ordinary weekly view without creating a canonical Pastafarian week.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Exact astronomical definition of local Pastafarian day boundary and role of location.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-App: WS13 physical DayId, Temporal Context, fallback location
Pastafarian-Calendar-Seer: calculation-day resolution/boundary logic and API docs
Pastafarian-Calendar: implementations that expose local day/today behavior
concepts.knownAnomaly: Hebrew Kisurra form differs: App 'כישורא' vs /about/ 'קיסורה'.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Definition of Pastafarian day span versus civil all-day span.
Exact anchor dates, axis encoding, distance and theological/computational interpretation.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar: all implementations and test vectors
concepts.specialTrap: Do not infer stale semantics from legacy variable names such as FOUNDATION_DAY_OLD.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Exact Sauce semantics including Q, drops, bowls, synchronous updates and final saved-sum R.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar: all implementation branches, especially JavaScript+Interlingue
research artifacts that depend on Sauce invertibility/history
concepts.specialTrap: Historical raw-sum reports must remain historical rather than be rewritten as if they never existed.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Exact short/wide selection algorithms and reachability/uniformity properties.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-Seer: exact runtime/optimization conformance where selection semantics are encoded
derived research or test vectors using selection distributions

concepts.corpusQuestion: Seer's semantic authority and project-world status of shortcutting prescribed work.
concepts.priorDecision: Seer is much faster/useful for integration, but the Monster does not approve the shortcut; semantic authority and liturgical approval are distinct.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Exact origin/re-delivery history and presentation rule.
concepts.priorDecision: 5 Aug 2026 is modern re-delivery, not creation; public calendar presentation should use a dynamically computed Pastafarian date rather than substitute the Gregorian date.

concepts.corpusQuestion: How the particular concrete details of the calendar were determined/created in project-world history.
concepts.priorDecision: The origin/creator material should explain how the calendar's details were determined, not only how to compute them.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Which premises are canonical; derived results remain theorem/empirical/open rather than rules.
concepts.specialTrap: Do not align derived numbers by copying them into canon; reprove/regenerate only when a premise changes.

concepts.corpusQuestion: Which previously approved project-theology decisions survive the new corpus.
surfaces: Pastafarian-Calendar-Seer: docs/RELATION_TO_THE_MONSTER.md where theology overlaps implementation
concepts.specialTrap: External-source absence does not mean lack of prior project approval; corpus nonetheless becomes superior authority.
